turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at twenty to five, so let's not waste it. Who decided to give my son a zero before anyone picked up a phone?
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
"Cheated." I'm writing that word down, Hale, along with the time you said it. You haven't shown me a single page yet, so put the proof on this desk or I'm walking upstairs to the principal.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.

I don't explain anything, Hale; you're the one who entered the zero. "Pasted" is your word, so turn the screen around and let me read the times myself. And tell me where the weekend drafts went, because Owen says he wrote it over the weekend.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.

Read me the line, word for word, and hand me the essay so I can check it against the play myself. And whatever you think that shows, Hale, nothing about this goes on his record, and none of it gets said in front of his class.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale? Then we're back to where we started: the zero comes off today, or I'm in the principal's office before my call.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

"Take it or leave it" isn't how procedure 4.4 reads, Hale, and you already skipped 4.2 when nobody called me before that zero went in. I'm not accepting anything from a teacher who just called my son a liar, so either the zero comes off the gradebook today or you can explain your terms to the principal with me in the room.
"Well" is my line, Hale. I'm waiting for your answer: the zero comes off, or we walk upstairs together.
